observations: body L1-L12: the end of the entry on the commentary on the Centiloquium (codex Orient. nr. 94), begun on p. XII.
body L2-L3: «آ» is printed as an alif with madda; «قال المفسّر» has a shadda over the sīn.

body L4-L9: the Arabic quotations from the codex: the heading of tract III (f. 24,r.), the first sentence («قال بطلميوس») with the commentator's words («قال المفسر»), and the titles of tracts IV, V and VIII. Each line holds the next part of the Arabic text, set right to left inside the Latin line as printed: on L4 the heading begins at the right margin and «قال بطلميوس (1)» follows on its left after a wide space (23 pt in the print), on L5 the sentence and, after a wide space (21 pt), the commentator's words; the wide spaces are kept ({gap:...}, enlarged in the ratio of the measures). L5 holds Arabic only and fills the measure in the print; the edition sets it from the indent, as its other lines. After the Arabic of L6, L7, L8 and L9 the Latin continues at the right of the Arabic run, as printed, so that the stop of L6 and L9 stands at the right end of the Arabic.
body L4, L7, L8: the numbers of sentences «يه» (15), «و» (6) and «د» (4) are abjad letters printed with a bar over them; transcribed without the bar.

body L14-L17: «Fr. Dieterici», «Pseudo–Abū Ma‘shar» and «Abī Ma‘shar» are letter-spaced; the dash of «Pseudo–Abū» is a long dash (6.0 pt). A dot before «p. 286» (L15), at the height of the letters, is a speck.
body L17, L37: the dot under the h of «al-ḥamīdiyyah» and «Muḥammad» prints joined to the letter, like a small arc.
body L18: «in–12o» has a long dash (5.4 pt) and a raised o; the plus sign of «121 + 2» is printed large.

body L33-L37: «Ahlwardt», «Quṭb ad-dīn ash-Shīrāzī», «Casiri» and «Muḥammad ibn Abī ’sh-Shukr» are letter-spaced; the hyphen of «278-79» is printed short (1.9 pt). The title «Tāǵ al-azyāǵ wa ghunyat al-muḥtāǵ» stands at the margin in italic as the abbreviation of its entry.

notes_left L1-L3, notes_right L1-L3: two notes in two columns; note 2, an Arabic text, begins after «(2)» on L3 of the left column and runs into the right column, each line of it set right to left from the right end of its part, the last part «عظاما الخ» at the left of the column, as printed. The elongated joins of «خلـق», «قـرار» and «علقـــة» are transcribed with tatweels. In note 1, «آضّد» is the alif with madda and the number ضد, 94 in the Maghribi values (ض = 90); the mark over the ض is printed as a shadda.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
